context:
This item asks which files the new aligned check reads. It does not block the PR.
Goal: a changed decision record never leaves a rule sentence that cites it out of date, in every file where rules live.
Problem (rule): debt aligned-skips-agents-skills. The aligned check in PR 3492 reads decision records and the rule sentences in the CLAUDE.md files. It skips the Markdown under agents/ and skills/, so a rule sentence there can fall out of date after its record changes, and nothing says so. Adding them widens what the check reads, so it is your call.
Based on (read): PR 3492 body, "Owner call, not blocking", read by triage at 03:19 CST Nov 15; coordinator relayed the lane's wording at 03:19 CST.
Based on (unmeasured): how many rule sentences sit under agents/ and skills/, and how often their records change.
Departs from: main — adds an aligned check that reads CLAUDE.md files only; the options differ on agents/ and skills/ Markdown.
Who recommends what: nobody has recommended an option; no star.
Meanwhile: PR 3492 is not held on this answer. The debt stays filed as aligned-skips-agents-skills.
